title: EQ II
excerpt: Parametric 2-band (filtered) stereo equaliser module for Orac 2.0 (Organelle) with a crossover frequency setting...
content:
Parametric 2-band (filtered) stereo equaliser module for Orac 2.0 (Organelle) with a crossover frequency setting, an optional low-cut (15hz) and minimalist OLED VU-meters.

press aux to show the revision number and global CPU usage

#1 copy eq2_1-5.zop into /Patches
#2 reload the Organelle (menu Storage -> Reload)
#3 run "Install eq2_1-5.zop"

v1.5 now installed into /media/orac/usermodules/fx , press aux to show infos

v1.4 is now only stereo (no more eq2/eq2s) with a bugfix : there was an issue when having more than one in a rack.
